about_the_game:
Enhance your Forza Horizon 5 adventures with new high-performing cars perfect for all the unique driving experiences the Horizon Festival offers. The Horizon Racing Car Pack introduces 4 incredible new-to-Forza cars for you to collect and drive including the spectacular 2023 Lotus Emira, 2022 Pagani Huayra R, 2021 Forsberg Racing Nissan ‘Altimaniac’ and 2020 Saleen Sportruck XR Black Label.

Once the pack is purchased, you are granted a one-time only, free addition of each car to your Forza Horizon 5 garage, with no additional in-game credit cost.

Requires Forza Horizon 5 (game sold separately). Not included with the Forza Horizon 5 Car Pass, Standard, Deluxe or Premium Editions.
